{{DISPLAYTITLE:doclusifer2}}
[[File:Doclusifer2 avatar.jpg|thumb|right|260px|doclusifer2.]]
'''doclusifer2''' is a 3-D modeler whose image is used on one [[Players Committee]] [[Virtual cards|Virtual card]].<ref name="cardlabels">[https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/resources/card_labels.json card_labels.json] in billbisco/swccg-gemp (commit 0bc4377d9): the printed labels of every Players Committee Virtual card, transcribed from the PC's card images (res.starwarsccg.org). Field definitions: [https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/docs/card_labels.md docs/card_labels.md].</ref> The card prints the credit as "Image courtesy of StarWars-Universe & doclusifer2 @ Sketchfab". The credit points to Sketchfab, a site for publishing 3-D models. The same credit line also names StarWars-Universe. The credited card is [[Tracked Fleet|•Tracked Fleet]], in [[Virtual Set 25]] (released 2025).
